title: Mini Poodle Hoodie Dog Lover Geometric Heart Front & Back
description:
Mini Poodle dog lover hoodie with geometric artwork, heart style. Layout: pocket portrait + full body back.

Unisex fit, soft and comfortable. Made to order and printed in the USA/EU by a Printify partner; allow about 10 business days to produce before shipping.

Art style: black ink on light colors, white ink on dark colors.
